hint.zh: 接入聊天软件收发消息。
hint.en: Sends and receives messages on a chat platform.

when.zh: 接入任意即时通讯平台收发消息（QQ、Discord、Telegram、微信等），或依附于这类 World 的功能包。
when.en: Connects to any instant-messaging platform (QQ, Discord, Telegram, WeChat, etc.), or extends such a World.

hint.zh: 接入 QQ，或是某个 QQ World 的功能包。
hint.en: Connects to QQ, or is an add-on for a QQ World.

when.zh: 接入 QQ 或依附于某个 QQ World。QQ 生态有大量依附于宿主的功能包，所以单独设一个平台标签；同时也贴 im。
when.en: Connects to QQ or extends a QQ World. QQ has many add-on packs tied to a host, so it gets its own platform tag; also tag im.

hint.zh: 成为偶像！为直播场景设计。
hint.en: Become an idol! Built for live streaming.

when.zh: 为直播场景设计：读直播间的弹幕、礼物、观众信号，或做直播演出（Live2D、字幕、OBS overlay）。只是在直播里玩过的游戏不算。
when.en: Built for live streaming: reads a live room's chat, gifts or audience signals, or performs for a stream (Live2D, subtitles, OBS overlay). A game that was merely played on stream does not count.

hint.zh: 接入、观察和操作游戏。
hint.en: Connects to, watches and plays games.

when.zh: 接入、观察或操作一个游戏，包括桌游规则与跑团检定。
when.en: Connects to, watches or plays a game, including tabletop rules and TRPG checks.

hint.zh: 涉及浏览器操作的功能。
hint.en: Operates a web browser.

when.zh: 打开、读取、点击网页，或内嵌一个网页。只是调 HTTP 接口不算。
when.en: Opens, reads or clicks web pages, or embeds a web page. Calling an HTTP API alone does not count.

hint.zh: 让 bot 看视频、读字幕或生成视频。
hint.en: Lets the bot watch videos, read subtitles or make videos.

when.zh: 让 bot 看视频或直播画面、读字幕，或生成视频。
when.en: Lets the bot watch videos or stream footage, read subtitles, or make videos.

hint.zh: 让 bot 听、说或通话。
hint.en: Lets the bot listen, speak or take calls.

when.zh: 让 bot 听（语音识别）、说（语音合成）或通话。
when.en: Lets the bot listen (speech recognition), speak (speech synthesis) or take calls.

hint.zh: 让 bot 操作电脑：鼠标、键盘和窗口。
hint.en: Lets the bot operate the computer: mouse, keyboard and windows.

when.zh: 让 bot 操作用户的电脑：鼠标、键盘、窗口。只读屏幕或前台窗口不算，那类由官方标「读取隐私」。
when.en: Lets the bot operate the user's computer: mouse, keyboard, windows. Only reading the screen or foreground window does not count; maintainers mark that as sensitive-data.

hint.zh: 涉及现实环境操作，如智能家居。
hint.en: Acts on the physical world, such as a smart home.

when.zh: 操作现实环境里的设备，如智能家居、机器人、传感器。
when.en: Operates devices in the physical world, such as smart homes, robots or sensors.

hint.zh: 接入、监听或操作其他应用程序。
hint.en: Connects to, watches or operates other applications.

when.zh: 接入、监听或操作其他应用程序。只有其他标签都不适用时才用。
when.en: Connects to, watches or operates other applications. Use it only when no other tag fits.

hint.zh: 帮 bot 记住、检索或整理过去的事。注意：我们不推荐通过 World 管理记忆和任何内部状态，请编写 Bot 扩展来处理内部状态管理。
hint.en: Helps the bot remember, search or tidy the past. Note: we do not recommend managing memory or any internal state in a World; write a bot extension for internal state.

when.zh: 帮 bot 记住、检索或整理过去的事：记忆库、聊天记录检索、笔记、相册、记忆体检。注意：我们不推荐通过 World 管理记忆和任何内部状态，请编写 Bot 扩展来处理内部状态管理。
when.en: Helps the bot remember, search or tidy the past: memory stores, chat history search, notes, albums, memory health checks. Note: we do not recommend managing memory or any internal state in a World; write a bot extension for internal state.

hint.zh: 情绪、好感、作息、时间感、节日、主动开口这类功能。注意：我们不推荐通过 World 管理记忆和任何内部状态，请编写 Bot 扩展来处理内部状态管理。
hint.en: Mood, affinity, daily routine, sense of time, festivals, speaking first. Note: we do not recommend managing memory or any internal state in a World; write a bot extension for internal state.

when.zh: 让 bot 更像一个有自己生活的伙伴：情绪、好感、作息、时间感、节日、主动开口。注意：我们不推荐通过 World 管理记忆和任何内部状态，请编写 Bot 扩展来处理内部状态管理。
when.en: Makes the bot feel like a companion with a life of its own: mood, affinity, daily routine, sense of time, festivals, speaking first. Note: we do not recommend managing memory or any internal state in a World; write a bot extension for internal state.

hint.zh: 让 bot 画画、生成图片这类作品。
hint.en: Lets the bot make works such as drawings and images.

when.zh: 让 bot 产出作品：画画、生成或修改图片、合成音频作品。
when.en: Lets the bot make things: drawing, generating or editing images, producing audio pieces.

hint.zh: 涉及 Cortico 框架内部诊断和自我管理的功能。注意：如无必要，我们不推荐通过 World 做这类功能，请发布单独的工具。
hint.en: Diagnoses or manages the Cortico framework itself. Note: unless necessary, we do not recommend building this as a World; publish a separate tool instead.

when.zh: 诊断或管理 Cortico 框架本身：用量与花费体检、记忆体检、配置收紧这类。注意：如无必要，我们不推荐通过 World 做这类功能，请发布单独的工具。
when.en: Diagnoses or manages the Cortico framework itself: usage and cost checks, memory health checks, tightening configuration. Note: unless necessary, we do not recommend building this as a World; publish a separate tool instead.

hint.zh: 在本机跑模型，需要本机算力或显存。
hint.en: Runs a model on this machine; needs local compute or VRAM.

when.zh: 在用户本机跑模型推理（LLM、语音识别、语音合成），需要本机算力或显存。
when.en: Runs model inference on the user's machine (LLM, speech recognition, speech synthesis) and needs local compute or VRAM.

hint.zh: 装上包还不能用，要先另装游戏、mod 加载器、NapCat 等。
hint.en: Needs something else installed first, such as the game, a mod loader or NapCat.

when.zh: 装上包还不能用，得先另装别的东西：游戏本体或 mod 加载器（BepInEx）、NapCat、VTube Studio、Python 环境、模型权重、游戏服务器。
when.en: Installing the package is not enough; something else must be set up first: the game itself or a mod loader (BepInEx), NapCat, VTube Studio, a Python environment, model weights, a game server.

hint.zh: 这个 World 在 bot 的 Memory 之外自己管理 bot 的内部状态（情绪、好感、记忆等），装上或卸下前后 bot 对自己的认知可能不一致。
hint.en: This World manages the bot's internal state (mood, affinity, memories) outside the bot's Memory, so the bot's sense of itself may differ before and after it is installed or removed.

when.zh: World 自己保存并注入 bot 的情绪、好感、记忆、经历这类内部状态。这类功能推荐在 bot 扩展的 Persona 里实现。
when.en: The World keeps and injects the bot's own internal state: mood, affinity, memories, experiences. We recommend building this into a bot extension's Persona instead.

hint.zh: 这个扩展依赖其他扩展才能正常运行，具体请查看说明。注意：我们强烈不建议引入任何 World 扩展之间的互相依赖，请将单个外部环境整合为单一 World，确为必要时优先通过订阅事件流等方式间接传递信号。
hint.en: This extension needs other extensions to work; see its README. Note: we strongly advise against dependencies between World extensions. Integrate one outside environment into a single World; where truly necessary, pass signals indirectly, for example by subscribing to the event stream.

when.zh: 这个扩展依赖其他扩展才能正常运行，具体请查看说明。注意：我们强烈不建议引入任何 World 扩展之间的互相依赖，请将单个外部环境整合为单一 World，确为必要时优先通过订阅事件流等方式间接传递信号。Bot 扩展不打这个标签。
when.en: This extension needs other extensions to work; see its README. Note: we strongly advise against dependencies between World extensions. Integrate one outside environment into a single World; where truly necessary, pass signals indirectly, for example by subscribing to the event stream. Bot extensions do not get this tag.

hint.zh: 这个扩展可能让 Token 消耗得很快。
hint.en: This extension may use tokens quickly.

when.zh: 会让 bot 频繁调用模型或每次带很多上下文，比如高频事件、持续截屏或视频帧、长文本注入。
when.en: Makes the bot call the model often or with large context, such as high-frequency events, continuous screenshots or video frames, or long injected text.

hint.zh: 模型能借它执行任意代码或命令、读写任意文件，或操控鼠标键盘。
hint.en: The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write any file, or control the mouse and keyboard.

when.zh: 模型能借它执行任意代码或命令、读写任意文件，或任意操控鼠标键盘。
when.en: The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write arbitrary files, or freely control the mouse and keyboard.

hint.zh: 会持续读取屏幕、麦克风、窗口等个人数据，并发给你配置的模型端点。
hint.en: Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone or windows, and sends it to your configured model endpoint.

when.zh: 会持续读取屏幕、麦克风、前台窗口或消费记录这类个人数据，并随模型调用发给模型端点。
when.en: Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone, foreground window or spending records, and sends it to the model endpoint with model calls.

hint.zh: 借用登录态或未公开接口调用服务，可能违反服务条款，账号有被限制的风险。
hint.en: Uses a login session or undocumented endpoint; may break the service's terms and put the account at risk.

when.zh: 借用网页登录态、CLI 额度或未公开接口调用服务，可能违反该服务的条款，账号有被限制的风险。
when.en: Calls a service through a web login session, a CLI quota or an undocumented endpoint; this may break the service's terms and put the account at risk.

note.en: Reads the desktop and spending records

note.zh: 读取前台窗口并定期截取游戏画面
note.en: Reads the foreground window and periodically captures the game screen
Reads the desktop and spending records

note.zh: 借用 Gemini 网页登录态
note.en: Uses a Gemini web login session

note.zh: 运行任意 Python 插件代码
读取前台窗口、键鼠空闲并能截屏
note.en: Reads the foreground window and input idle time, and can take screenshots

note.zh: 借用 Gemini 网页登录态
note.en: Uses a Gemini web login session
